name: Brali reviewed outcome observations
description: Versioned public observations accepted after explicit consent, schema validation, privacy review and provenance review. The empty array is an observed zero, not a placeholder for synthetic usage.
notes: No demo, test, generated or repository event belongs in this file.
A submitted GitHub issue does not become a public observation automatically.
Negative, not-helpful and no-answer outcomes are eligible when they meet the same privacy and provenance rules.
